div.div: مُتَعَبْهِلٌ i. q. مُمْتَنِعٌ [app. as meaning One who resists, or withstands; or who is incompliant, or unyielding]: (K:) and [so in copies of the K and in the TA, but in the CK “ or, ”] one who will not be prevented, or withheld, from a thing. (O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
